policy: Private network identities, host paths, GPU UUIDs, and unrelated stdout/stderr are omitted or replaced with generic role labels; numeric measurements, request IDs, model/runtime pins and failures retained. No credential fields are published.
native_job_artifacts: Native benchmark-evidence/v1 retained; stage hashes and byte sizes recomputed after sanitization. Raw originals remain operator-private.
image_corpus: Only corpus.path made repository-relative; corpus and image content digests retained.
historical_copies: Windows capacity/endurance raw copies retained unchanged for local graph provenance.
mutation: Publication sanitization only; no serving configuration changes.
